navigator_advisories_note: G3c: the generic degenerate checks of the navigator map (the view model is built in the browser, so the kernel's view engine cannot evaluate it): the same codes and the same loom.advisory/1 shape as the kernel's (nothing_visible, marks_identical). All presets, any value works: min_elements = how many marks a channel needs before 'all identical' is said (0 or 1 = even a single mark; a huge number = never); invisible_at_or_below per channel (absent = the channel cannot vanish); channels = which channels of a mark are checked and which data they show (words for the sentence). The fingerprint is the declaration id + channel (the mapping is the configuration, not the data), so 'don't ask' holds for this mapping on any level. Reverse: delete a channel here = it is no longer checked. advise_on_defaults (preset false): false = a channel is checked only when its mapping (setting navigator_mapping: channel -> what it shows) differs from default_mapping, i.e. the person or a profile changed it - the app's own default is not a question to the person; true = every channel is checked. The shipped mapping is data/navigator_mapping.json 'default' (G3d: one place; default_mapping here, when present, overrides it for the checks only). Reverse: set advise_on_defaults true. G3d: channel_unknown (the setting names a channel the map does not draw: nothing is drawn for it, nothing refused) and measure_missing (no mark of the level has the measure: every mark draws the channel's preset; the generic 'all identical' is then not repeated) come from the mapping report of the level.

nothing_visible.en: Nothing is visible on the channel '{channel}': {invisible} of {total} marks are at or below {threshold} (it shows: {shows}).
nothing_visible.pl: Na kanale '{channel}' nic nie widać: {invisible} z {total} znaczników ma wartość nie większą niż {threshold} (pokazuje: {shows}).

marks_identical.en: All {total} marks get the same value {value} on the channel '{channel}', so it tells them apart by nothing (it shows: {shows}).
marks_identical.pl: Wszystkie {total} znaczniki mają na kanale '{channel}' tę samą wartość {value}, więc niczym ich nie rozróżnia (pokazuje: {shows}).

measure_missing.pl: Kanał '{channel}' ma pokazywać {measure}, ale żaden z {total} znaczników nie ma tej wartości, więc wszystkie są rysowane tak samo (wartość domyślna kanału).
measure_missing.en: The channel '{channel}' is set to show {measure}, but none of the {total} marks has that value, so all of them are drawn alike (the channel's preset).

channel_unknown.pl: Ustawienie wskazuje kanał '{channel}' (pokazuje: {measure}), którego mapa nie rysuje, więc nic się od niego nie zmienia.
channel_unknown.en: The setting names the channel '{channel}' (it shows: {measure}), which the map does not draw, so nothing changes because of it.
